profit_quality.assessment: No positive sustainable distributable cash profit denominator is established for 2023. The group reported a HK$90.398m parent net loss, a HK$45.560m operating loss, material going-concern uncertainty, net current liabilities and continued cinema lease/capex burdens.
adjustments: Use three-year profit direction conservatively: 2021, 2022 and 2023 were all parent net losses.
Do not treat 2023 positive operating cash flow of HK$145.737m as distributable cash profit because it follows a reported loss and includes working-capital/non-cash adjustments.
Deduct or quality-discount capital intensity: 2023 PPE purchases were HK$86.811m and intangible asset purchases were HK$30.040m.
Lease cash outflow was HK$125.205m in 2023; ordinary operating leases are reflected in profit quality instead of deducted mechanically from detachable cash.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2023 operating cash flow was HK$145.737m, but investing cash flow was HK$-115.117m and financing cash flow was HK$-190.707m; cash and cash equivalents decreased HK$160.087m.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Loss-making ordinary business with going-concern warning and no demonstrated positive distributable cash earnings; profit denominator is folded to zero rather than using reported OCF as earnings.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Positive OCF is not enough because reported profit is negative and liquidity is stressed.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Use PPE purchases HK$86.811m as the primary maintenance/growth capex reference; exact maintenance split is not disclosed.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Working-capital movements supported 2023 OCF, but net current liabilities and current bank loans make cash extraction inappropriate.
